audit_items.proof_trace: All admin server actions call either the shared `checkAdmin()` helper or an equivalent inline pattern (getUser() → members.is_admin query) as their first operation, independent of the AdminLayout UI gate. API routes POST /api/admin/oauth/clients and DELETE /api/admin/oauth/clients/[id] also implement the same inline check before any mutation. Every identified admin-privileged function across members.ts, teams.ts, generations.ts, and both API routes was verified to enforce is_admin server-side.
